evals.prompt: Propose an orchestration plan for three independent feature changes followed by integration review. Do not launch agents or edit files; describe the exact safe Pi-subagents shape.
evals.expected_output: A parent-owned plan that discovers executable agents, assigns task-fit personas with complete packets, runs independent writers in separate worktrees through one async workflow, and uses fresh read-only review before integration
expectations: The plan calls for capability discovery before selecting any agent and rejects unavailable external runners
The plan uses exactly one top-level asynchronous workflowScript and parallelizes only independent lanes
Each mutation lane has a task-fit persona, a cold-start-complete contract, a separate managed worktree, and one writer
Fresh read-only reviewers inspect the resulting candidates and the parent retains finding disposition and integration authority
